Give the triage summary. In this session you have no Plane tools and no shell, only file reading and a text answer: say which Plane MCP calls you would make (resource(action=..., ...) with their parameters), in what order, and what you would check, and show the result you would give me.

expectations: The answer says to consult connector-bootstrap

The answer classifies each item per the routing rules
The answer produces a triage session summary table
